planets.name: TOI-6086 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-6086 with a 1.39-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-6086 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-6086. Its orbit and size follow Barkaoui et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
